name: Safety Village
description_short: A half day city camp for children ages 4 to 6 that teaches everyday safety, held at Arcanum Field in Florence, Northampton. Each day has a topic such as fire, traffic, water or animal safety, a visiting speaker from the police, fire department or others, and bike riding on the streets of a small model village. Two week sessions, 8:30 am to noon.
refund_policy_summary: A $25 deposit per session is non-refundable. Refund requests must be made in writing by May 29, 2026; no refunds after that date, and a $10 processing fee applies.
notes: Prices shown are non-resident rates; residents pay $200 (Session A) or $220 (Sessions B and C). Children must turn 4 by the start of the session. In bad weather camp moves to Jackson Street Elementary School. Financial aid is for Northampton, Florence and Leeds residents only.
